title: Gideon and the Language
author: Lena Whitlock
blurb: Sable Eastwick, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
